items.followUp: Which organisms were placed in kingdom Protista in Haeckel’s three-kingdom system?

rubric.why: The two-kingdom system did not provide a suitable place for some organisms.
rubric.description: States that the two-kingdom system was inadequate for classifying some organisms.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the limitation of the two-kingdom system.

rubric.why: Protista provided a separate group for organisms that did not fit properly in Plantae or Animalia.
rubric.description: States that Haeckel added Protista as a third kingdom for these organisms.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming Protista and its role as the third kingdom.

modelAnswer: The two-kingdom system was inadequate because many organisms, especially unicellular organisms, could not be placed properly in either Plantae or Animalia.
Therefore, Haeckel proposed a third kingdom, Protista, for these organisms.
